entities.name: Assemble a semantic runtime-closure manifest
entities.summary: Join one accepted reachability receipt with one exact artifact variant per reachable semantic value and emit a canonical content-addressed compiler-to-build closure manifest.

acceptance: One primitive snapshot JSON witness is total-byte bounded, decoded to an inert name-free projection, and admitted by accepted 0027 replay before one normalized private-store observation
Members cover the reachable set exactly and exclude every unreachable or outside-universe value
Artifact selection remains explicitly caller-selected and distinct from dependency-edge authority
Manifest bytes and identity are deterministic, permutation invariant, and sensitive to exact artifact variants
Malformed, forged, stale, over-limit, and digest-failing inputs return typed failures without a manifest

relations.summary: The manifest embeds and revalidates the accepted bounded reachability analysis.
Exact artifact variants and semantic membership come from one bounded snapshot JSON witness decoded to an inert name-free store projection.
The manifest establishes a transport-neutral input closure without claiming publication or deployment.
